titolo: What If Every Car on Earth Stopped Working Tomorrow?

scene.testo: Tomorrow morning, every car on Earth stops working.
Engines dead. Dashboards dark. Nothing will restart them.
There are well over one billion cars on our planet.
Every single one sits frozen exactly where it stopped.
Highways become the largest parking lots in history.
Ambulances stop in the middle of crowded streets.
School buses, taxis and police cars all go silent.
Delivery trucks stand still, loaded with food and medicine.
In the United States, trucks carry most of the freight.
Most grocery stores hold only a few days of stock.
After that, the shelves begin to empty.
Farmers cannot bring harvests to the cities.
Millions would be forced to walk to work.
Overnight, bicycles would become the most valuable machines around.
But that's not the strangest part.
The real shock arrives in the following weeks.
Stay with me, and I'll explain it step by step.
